title: Scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deck' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8a3d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8621a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='column' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe17a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f2b632'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='14' fill='#5ad1ff'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#9beaff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='6' fill='#c8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#3aa8d8'/>

  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='14' fill='#5ad1ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#9beaff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='6' fill='#c8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#3aa8d8'/>

  <!-- deck -->
  <path d='M24 63 Q28 58 40 58 L64 58 Q74 58 78 63 L80 68 Q78 72 68 72 L36 72 Q26 72 24 68 Z' fill='url(#deck)'/>
  <rect x='36' y='61.5' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd9b3'/>

  <!-- neck / column -->
  <path d='M70 64 L80 30 L86 31 L78 66 Q74 68 70 64 Z' fill='url(#column)'/>
  <rect x='77' y='28' width='11' height='4' rx='2' fill='#fff1b8' transform='rotate(-20 82 30)'/>

  <!-- handlebar post -->
  <rect x='79' y='18' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8552e' transform='rotate(-20 82 25)'/>

  <!-- handlebars -->
  <path d='M72 20 Q82 12 94 18' fill='none' stroke='#ff6b3d' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='21' r='4' fill='#ffb199'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='18' r='4' fill='#ffb199'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx='83' cy='36' r='5' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
